data.summary: The fun, fun, fun never stops.
data.meta_title: Twitch Drops: Loot Up from October 14–27
data.content:
The battle is heating up on the Wild Ten!

Prepare for the chaos of Season 3: Battle for Tortuga, where shifting alliances and intense battles await as the fragile peace on Tortuga shatters. From October 14–27 (12:00 UTC), tune in to select Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers Twitch streams to earn the following rewards:

Watch for:

Twitch Drop:

30 minutes

2,000 Credits 

1 hour

3-Day Premium

1 hour, 30 minutes 

10,000 Salvage

2 hours

1x Magneto Weapon

2 hours, 30 minutes

100 Intel
3 hours 1x Shocktrain Weapon

3 hour, 30 minutes

2x Tyr Shoulder
4 hours 1x Ares Chassis
4 hour, 30 minutes 1x Pursuer Torso

Claiming Rewards From Twitch Drops

Your rewards will appear in your Drops Inventory when you’ve accumulated enough watch time to earn them. Make sure your account is linked, and be sure to claim them while Drops are active. 

How To Link Your Twitch And War Robots: Frontiers Accounts

To claim your items, you must link your War Robots: Frontiers account with your Twitch account:
 

  • Log in via the official website.
    • Make sure you log in with the platform and account you want to receive your Twitch Drops on. For example, if you play War Robots: Frontiers on Steam you should log in using Steam authentication. 
  • Select ‘Link with Twitch’ and confirm the connection.
  • You’re all set! Watch Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers streams on Twitch to start earning Twitch Drops.

Where To Watch War Robots: Frontiers On Twitch

Check out the War Robots: Frontiers game directory on Twitch and be on the lookout for streams with Drops in their titles!

Content Creators: How To Enable War Robots: Frontiers Drops On Twitch

Any streamer playing War Robots: Frontiers can participate in this Twitch Drops campaign! If you want to enable Twitch Drops on your channel, all you need to do is: 

  • Enable Drops in your Creator Dashboard on Twitch (do this in ‘Viewer Rewards’ from your channel settings).
  • Start streaming War Robots: Frontiers to your audience!

To get a heads-up on future Twitch Drops campaigns for War Robots: Frontiers, join the Content Creator Program.
